about: Translucent model textures (issue #438): a texture with its own alpha channel (a TGA) is blended after the sprites, back to front, so its soft edges and see-through parts show; opaque texels need alpha 207 and up, and only exact #FF00FF is keyed. Izlude's enchant model (iz_enchant.rsm, north of 89,116) and Dicastes' factory models use TGA textures.
